summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化AlSi10Mg合金的动态力学行为
summary_zh.method: 进行动态压缩或拉伸实验，分析应变率效应

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the dynamic mechanical behavior of AlSi10Mg alloy fabricated by selective laser melting for potential engineering applications.
summary_en.method: Dynamic compression or tensile tests were conducted at various strain rates to characterize the strain rate sensitivity and failure mechanisms.
summary_en.result: The alloy exhibited significant strain rate dependence, with increased strength and altered failure modes under dynamic loading.
summary_en.validation: Experimental results were validated through repeat tests and compared with quasi-static data, but no biomedical or implant-specific validation was performed.

papers.title: Critical Buckling Load for Lattice Column Elements with Variable Dimensions
papers.abstract: <p>Lattice structures are used in a variety of high-value engineering applications; for example, in automobile, aerospace and biomedical applications, due to their light weight, high specific strength, stiffness, heat transfer control and energy absorption. Additive Manufacturing (AM) technologies, such as Selective Laser Melting (SLM), offer radical net-shape manufacturing solutions for metallic structures directly from digital data. The prediction of AM lattice structure mechanical properties prior to manufacture is both cost and time-consuming; particularly as existing models do not readily accommodate the effects of manufacturing defects and lattice node geometry on column buckling. The critical buckling load of columns was algebraically and numerically simulated for a full Design of Experiments (DOE) of independent variables, including column length, column radius, node radius and material type. This simulation data quantifies the effect of independent variables on critical buckling load and demonstrates the limitations of algebraically prediction. This research can be extended to allow the simulation of the load carrying capacity of entire lattice structures; and to accommodate the effect of manufacturing variation on the associated load carrying capacity of AM lattice structures.</p>

summary_zh.method: 通过代数计算和数值模拟分析柱长、半径等参数对临界屈曲载荷的影响。
summary_zh.result: 发现节点几何和制造缺陷会限制代数预测的准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To predict the critical buckling load of lattice columns fabricated by additive manufacturing, considering geometric parameters.
summary_en.method: Algebraic calculations and numerical simulations were performed for a design of experiments varying column length, radius, node radius, and material.
summary_en.result: The simulation data reveals limitations of algebraic prediction and the need to account for manufacturing defects and node geometry.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; purely numerical simulation.

papers.title: Chitosan-Recombinamer Layer-by-Layer Coatings for Multifunctional Implants.
papers.abstract: The main clinical problems for dental implants are (1) formation of biofilm around the implant-a condition known as peri-implantitis and (2) inadequate bone formation around the implant-lack of osseointegration. Therefore, developing an implant to overcome these problems is of significant interest to the dental community. Chitosan has been reported to have good biocompatibility and anti-bacterial activity. An osseo-inductive recombinant elastin-like biopolymer (P-HAP), that contains a peptide derived from the protein statherin, has been reported to induce biomineralization and osteoblast differentiation. In this study, chitosan/P-HAP bi-layers were built on a titanium surface using a layer-by-layer (LbL) assembly technique. The difference in the water contact angle between consecutive layers, the representative peaks in diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform spectroscopy (DRIFTS), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and the changes in the topography between surfaces with a different number of bi-layers observed using atomic force microscopy (AFM), all indicated the successful establishment of chitosan/P-HAP LbL assembly on the titanium surface. The LbL-modified surfaces showed increased biomineralization, an appropriate mouse pre-osteoblastic cell response, and significant anti-bacterial activity against Streptococcus gordonii, a primary colonizer of tissues in the oral environment.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决牙种植体的感染和骨整合不足问题。
summary_zh.method: 在钛表面层-层组装壳聚糖和重组弹性蛋白样生物聚合物涂层。
summary_zh.result: 涂层提高了矿化能力、细胞反应并抑制革兰氏阳性菌。
summary_zh.validation: 通过接触角、光谱、AFM表征及体外细胞和抗菌实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address peri-implantitis and inadequate osseointegration in dental implants through multifunctional coatings.
summary_en.method: Layer-by-layer assembly of chitosan and recombinant elastin-like polymer (P-HAP) on titanium surfaces.
summary_en.result: Coated surfaces exhibited enhanced biomineralization, pre-osteoblast response, and antibacterial activity against Streptococcus gordonii.
summary_en.validation: Characterized by contact angle, DRIFTS, XPS, AFM, and validated through in vitro biomineralization, cell assays, and antibacterial tests.
